proof_obligation: A non-cube a with even m = floor_cbrt(a^8) never satisfies (m+1)^3 - a^8 <= 2 a^4. That is the only remaining shape of an odd non-square n with T(n)=a^4.

parity_constraints.even_a_implies_even_n: observed on the hit set; not a theorem
parity_constraints.odd_square_n_iff_a_odd_cube: observed on [1, 10^8); Lean for odd m
parity_constraints.inexact_cube_implies_even_n: Lean when m is odd; leftover is even m

possible_lemma: T(n)=a^4 and n odd implies n is a square. Lean only under odd m. Do not treat the empty odd-non-square search as this lemma.
note: At most one cube fits in [a^8, (a^4+1)^2). Finite emptiness of the even-m leftover is not a theorem.
